checks.name: frozen-artifact-semantic-audit
checks.command: jq -e '(.outcome == "falsified") and (.observations.first_failure == "same-closure-evidence-two") and (.observations.trace.constructions | length == 14) and (.observations.trace.closures | length == 35) and (.exact_replay == true) and (.naturally_quiescent == true)' research/campaigns/hand-causal-lineage-preservation-v1/artifacts/hand-causal-lineage-preservation.json

findings: The implementation is isolated behind RecursiveLearnerCausalLineage; the existing recursive construction control still passes and the default protocol is unchanged.
CausalLineage is temporary, sorted, unique, order-independent, checkpointed with pending candidate firings, and populated only from actual incoming firing provenance.
Two carried causes remain one physical edge firing: primitive output count and impulse equal the scalar reference, while reversed and duplicate inputs preserve set laws.

Return processing applies the local physical outcome once per return firing, records consequence for distinct owners, and independently attempts reverse consolidation for each distinct admitted origin.
The candidate repaired the frozen missing transition: delivered surfaces 10002 and 10001 appeared at modulatory incidence, were admitted, and reverse-consolidated.
The preregistered complete solve was correctly classified as falsified because the chronological first closure key (parent none, surface 3, output 11) did not renew at evidence two.

Other exact anonymous closure keys produced thirty-five closure observations and fourteen constructions. This was preserved as a separate contract/selectivity observation and was not used to relabel the failed arm.
The candidate changed position on nine of sixteen steps but reached neither reflected limit, so lineage preservation is not sufficient for closed one-joint control.
Every active core test and all four successor experiment tests pass; the independent warm experiment suite completed in 0.87 seconds, strictly under 10 seconds.
residual_uncertainty: The shared Firing representation now contains an optional lineage field even for old protocols. Functional and replay controls pass, but cross-version checkpoint byte compatibility and exact historical bytes-touched equality were not claimed or independently established.
The evidence does not yet determine whether fourteen constructions are valid discovery of multiple nested causal boundaries or overly broad construction caused by lineage fan-in.
Whether the developmental claim requires renewal of the chronologically first closure or permits any repeated actual anonymous closure is a separate frozen contract question.
No removal ablation was run because the complete preregistered candidate failed; necessity, adoption, reflected-limit control, finger development, and hand capability remain unestablished.
